machine: Apple M5, ANGLE Metal. Build gates and perf_1080 ran on 3154d165c (round 2 closed, nothing else running). From 23:19 other sessions committed and ran heavy jobs non-stop: owner-requested clicks and pathing (rulings 33 and 35: 0fd6a83cb, 09cdc2779, e71569221), ambience (ruling 34: 4f33c7b11), and their probe, bot-soak, controls and audio-match runs held 1-3 heavy slots with 1-min load up to 70. So the later gates measured a moving tree. The HEAD for each gate is recorded.
summary: No round-2 change breaks a hard gate, so nothing was reverted and no fix commit was needed. perf_1080 --prod on 3154d165c: every frame, draw, program, calibration, dynres and gpubound check passes. Its one GATE FAIL line was menu GPU growth +7.9 % (580 -> 626 MB, tracked materials and geometries flat). A --mem-only re-run on the same bench read +0.0 % and printed GATE PASS, so that line was driver noise, not a leak. Watch: match seed 11 peaked at 497k triangles (bar 500k; round 1 462k, other lanes' round-2 runs 451-456k). Seeds 7 and 23 read 451k and 459k. The real-time match ran 3 times and was not measured all 3 times: a load spike to 6.78; a stall during outside activity (appleaccountd, the owner's own Chrome); then 390 s of 1-3 fps throttling while the owner was active and another session's probe held a slot. Match memory was not measured 3 times because of other sessions' jobs (load max 67-70). It would pass every time: RIFT 2677 / 2684 / 2784 MB, BRIDGE 2436 / 2507 / 2398 MB (round 1 RIFT 2865). Passed: e2e all (0 console lines), probe_audio_runtime match on seeds 3/7/11/21, combat_polish ult,hold for all 16, gen_store --check (32/32). These ran under outside load, so for the '< 3 (clean)' class they are pass evidence, not idle closing evidence. Audio sync passed 3/3, but its rAF gates were not armed (pump-late p95 16-20 ms at load 33), so it is not closing evidence. Three findings are not round-2 regressions. (1) value_probe fray_low.fighterTop25 85.3 > 85: commit 0fd6a83cb (ruling 33) changed the seed-7 sim, so different fighters stand in every value_probe shot, and FRAY now frames Tunlan, whose top quarter reads 85.7 under FRAY's plate light (82.4 on BRIDGE, unchanged from round 1). (2) npm run probe at 09cdc2779: probe_sim_bot_soak veteran laners in lane 62.3 % < 65 %, after the same pathing work; that session is soak-testing it now. It passed 55/55 on 3154d165c. (3) card_qa: 7 blank-face blocker misses on the Burdam (3) and Dunsom (3) splashes and on ilsheta_stillwater splash. The cards lane already recorded these (verify_r2_bd2, verify_r2_g1b).
